description: This file defines a LightningJS component called 'EditorPane' for a note editing interface, handling note display, editing, autosaving, and deletion confirmation.

classes.name: EditorPane
classes.description: A LightningJS component for editing notes, including title and content, with autosave and delete functionality.

methods.name: autosave
methods.description: Saves the current note's title and content using NoteService and updates the lastSavedAt timestamp.

methods.name: focusTitle
methods.description: Sets focus to the title input area.

methods.name: focusContent
methods.description: Sets focus to the content input area.

methods.name: $onDelete
methods.description: Triggers display of delete confirmation dialog.

methods.name: $confirmDelete
methods.description: Handles user confirmation for deleting the note; calls NoteService.deleteNote if confirmed.
